name: Car Light Production Line Solution
summary: A complete line automation solution for automotive lighting manufacturers, covering lens assembly, reflector installation, LED module assembly, seal inspection, and final packaging.
contentHtml:
The car light production line solution is a complete line automation solution provided by TXAM for automotive parts manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The entire line covers the full process including lens assembly, reflector installation, LED module assembly, circuit connection, seal inspection, and final packaging.

Solution Advantages

  • Precision assembly ensures optical performance
  • Automated helium leak detection ensures sealing
  • Multi-model flexible production
  • Complies with automotive industry standards
  • Turnkey project service

Service Content

Provides full-process support including line planning, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning, and after-sales service.
